name: amazon-toolbox
description: 面向跨境电商业务的桌面自动化效率工具箱
author: Amazon Toolbox Team

scripts.build:desktop: set "TOOLBOX_BUILD_TARGET=electron"&& set "TEMP=D:\AmazonToolboxData\build-tmp"&& set "TMP=D:\AmazonToolboxData\build-tmp"&& vite build --mode production
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath build\dist --workpath build\work toolbox-backend.spec && copy /Y build\dist\toolbox-backend.exe ..\electron\toolbox-backend.exe
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && set "ELECTRON_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-cache"&& set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-builder-cache"&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.electron:release: npm run release:validate && npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && set "ELECTRON_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-cache"&& set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-builder-cache"&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.test: npm run electron:compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:electron-workflow
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.openapi:check: python scripts/export_openapi.py --output backend/openapi.json --check && python scripts/check_openapi_compat.py && python scripts/generate_openapi_types.py --check
scripts.desktop:verify-package: npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && set "ELECTRON_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-cache"&& set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-builder-cache"&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --win --dir && npm run package:audit
scripts.docker:test:mariadb: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f compose.yaml --profile test run --rm backend-tests
scripts.verify:backend:static: python -m ruff check backend && python -m mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app backend/core backend/domains backend/services backend/routers
scripts.verify:backend: npm run test:backend && npm run verify:backend:static
scripts.verify: npm run security:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run architecture:check && npm run openapi:check && npm run deadcode && npm test && npm run build:desktop && npm run verify:backend
scripts.verify:release: npm run security:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run architecture:check && npm run openapi:check && npm run deadcode && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:backend:coverage && npm run test:backend:diff-coverage && npm run verify:backend:static && npm run test:mariadb:required && npm run test:e2e:business && npm run test:e2e:internal && npm run desktop:verify-package

build.productName: 跨境电商赛训效率工具箱
